purpose: Tape-verified OHLC bars that must survive any warehouse rebuild. The daily updater (tools/update-ohlc-archive.js) and the p21 backfill merge are both fill-missing-only, so they never overwrite these bars on this machine — but a warehouse rebuilt from scratch (fresh machine, or monthly archives re-fetched from the feed) would restore the feed's bars or drop the gap-fill rows. tools/apply-ohlc-corrections.py re-applies exactly these bars, deterministically and idempotently, to both stores (ohlc-db per-symbol files and ohlc-YYYY-MM.json monthly files).
